description:
A hand-pasted advert, hung crooked, on paper thin enough to show the wall through it. Most of it is Grady, photographed from below with his arms folded over the vendor's apron, gazing off toward a horizon located roughly above the vending machine.

TWO-CELL SUPPLY. EAST ALONG THE STREET. OPPORTUNITIES AVAILABLE.

"FRESH OUT OF THE VAT? NO CREDITS? GOOD. That's my favourite kind of customer." Then the list. HONEST PRICES. HONEST WORK. TRAINING RIG ON PREMISES. GEAR FOR EVERY CAREER PATH, INCLUDING THE ONES YOU WOULDN'T PUT ON A FORM.
name: an advert for Two-Cell Supply
